result:
If I could change just one thing, I’d make empathy unavoidable—not by forcing people to agree, but by making it structurally impossible for anyone to remain invisible, unheard, or materially terrified.

Most cruelty, stupidity, and waste don’t come from evil people. They come from isolation, scarcity, and the inability to see someone else’s life at full resolution. Change one thing: guarantee that every person has the security to think clearly and the direct exposure to understand that others suffer and dream in the same language they do.

Everything else—violence, corruption, stagnation, burnout—softens once that gap closes. Not because I want to "help," but because that single shift has more leverage than any law, technology, or revolution.
